description:
You are a legal paralegal at a law firm that has just received a litigation hold notice for the case 'Meridian Corp v. Acme Industries' (Case No. 2025-CV-04891). A 'Litigation Hold Notice' document in the Projects workspace specifies the scope of documents that must be preserved.

Your task is to implement the litigation hold:
1. Review the Litigation Hold Notice to understand which documents fall within the scope of the hold
2. For each in-scope document, apply the tag 'legal-hold'
3. For each in-scope document, add a comment stating: 'Document placed under litigation hold per Case No. 2025-CV-04891. Do not modify, delete, or relocate.'
4. Remove all access permissions for user 'outside-counsel' from documents under the hold (this user's access is being reviewed as part of the litigation)
5. Create a collection called 'Litigation Hold - Meridian v Acme' and add all in-scope documents to it
6. Do NOT apply the hold to documents that are outside the stated scope

Login credentials: Administrator / Administrator
